title: Eisenhower's granddaughter is an abductee

tellings.quote: So if you know Eisenhower's granddaughter is an abductee and is like all over this issue

plain: A granddaughter of President Dwight Eisenhower, Laura Eisenhower, is described as an abductee, meaning someone who says she has been taken by non-human beings, and as deeply involved in the UFO subject. Michels brings this up himself, in passing, without naming a source. He raises it as a striking link between a former president's family and the topic.
